remarks: Experience urban living at its finest in this spacious, renovated 2-bedroom, 2 full bathroom corner apartment located in the heart of Downtown Stamford. This home has been freshly painted and features crown molding throughout, a large living room, dining room and a sleek open concept kitchen with breakfast bar. Both bathrooms are ensuite and feature heated floors and contemporary updates. The Hayes House provides an array of amenities, including 24 hour security, concierge, a convenient parking garage for your reserved parking spot with additional spots available, guest parking, a fully equipped gym, secure storage and a community deck with panoramic city views. Pets are welcome, making this an ideal home for all. The monthly HOA includes heat and hot water. Enjoy hassle-free living just steps away from the best dining, shopping and entertainment. 7 min to Interstate 95 & Stamford Railroad Station. Your perfect downtown retreat awaits!
